title: Exceptional transport normalization laws
statement: Given TransportCoreData, there exists the indicated normalization compatibility law package.

source.place: Constructions 4.1 and 5.25, Lemma 5.22 and Propositions 5.24 and 5.26

proof.text: The package is obtained by the corresponding strict-system transport calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_exceptional_transport_core_normalization_laws
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s))
    (d : TransportCoreData l Ω D hl c operation left) :
    Nonempty (TransportCoreNormalizationLaws l Ω D hl c operation left d)
